snippet.title: EARTHS EDGE | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Earths Edge now ! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3074980/Earths_Edge/

Hello!
We are TeaMug Studios, a game development Studio from Germany with their first game announcement! Earths Edge is a fast paced, hybrid mech combat, cooperative first person shooter for up to four players. Command and customize your EM-BR mech, fight against rival factions, and confront a growing threat twisted by the unknown Lunom ore.

Thank you for watching our trailer !
If you liked what you saw, please consider liking, subscribing, and sharing the video,  every bit of support helps us grow our game. We’d love to hear your thoughts on your first impressions of Earth’s Edge, your feedback is important !

Join the community Discord to chat with the devs, suggest features, meet new people, and stay updated on exclusive content about the development:
👉 https://discord.com/invite/Pv9yaduH8t

Follow us on our socials for more updates and insights into the development of Earth’s Edge!

Visit our Website:
https://teamugstudios.com/

Follows our socials:
https://discord.com/invite/Pv9yaduH8t
https://www.instagram.com/teamug_studio/
https://x.com/TeaMug_Studios
https://www.tiktok.com/@teamugstudios
